---
title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---


```{r}
coffee <- read.csv("coffee_exports.csv", check.names = FALSE)
glimpse(coffe)
```


```{r}

coffee_longer <- coffee %>% 
  pivot_longer( !country,
                names_to = "year",
                values_to = "count")

coffee_longer$year <- as.numeric(coffee_longer$year)

```

```{r}
coffee_br_co <- coffee_longer %>% 
  filter(country == "Brazil" | country == "Colombia")

ggplot(coffee_br_co,aes(x= year, y= count))+
  geom_line(aes(color = country))
```

```{r}
coffee_longer <- coffee_longer %>% 
  group_by( year ) %>% 
  mutate(rank = rank( desc( count ) ) )

coffee_longer
```

```{r}

coffee_br_co_vn <- coffee_longer %>%
filter( country == "Brazil" | country == "Colombia" | country == "Viet Nam")

ggplot(coffee_br_co_vn,aes(x= year, y= -rank))+
  geom_line(aes(color = country))

```
